name: Expert Rider
body:
Your time in the saddle has granted you extraordinary control over your mount.

Prerequisites: Mounted Combat

Benefit(s): If a creature you are riding needs to make an Acrobatics, Climb, Escape Artist, Stealth, or Swim check you may make a Ride check in place of that skill.

If the creature has any bonuses to the skill check required, you add them as bonuses to your Ride check.
